meta.name: infographic-generator
meta.description: Generate branded infographic specifications from any content or data. Outputs structured layout, copy, data visualization, and color scheme — ready to render as HTML/CSS, Satori, Canva, or any design tool. Use this skill when the user wants an infographic, data visual, social media image, comparison chart, stat card, or says "create an infographic for [content]", "make a visual for my LinkedIn post", "design an image for [topic]", "stat graphic for [data]", "comparison infographic", "branded image", "social media graphic", "infographic for [blog post]", "data visualization", "visual content", "image for my post", "LinkedIn carousel image", "feature comparison chart", "pricing table image".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意内容转为品牌信息图的设计规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为内容制作品牌信息图
copy.tagline_en: Turn any content into branded infographic design specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need branded infographics for your content

howto.what: Claude会根据你提供的文字或数据，自动生成一张信息图的完整设计规范，包括布局、文案、数据点和配色方案，输出为JSON或HTML，可直接用于Canva、Figma等工具。
howto.when: 当你提到“创建信息图”、“数据可视化”、“社交媒体图”等关键词，或要求制作对比图、统计卡片时触发。

say.text: 为这篇博客文章创建一个信息图
say.note: 会生成包含布局和文案的规范。

say.text: 把我的LinkedIn帖子做成一张对比图
say.note: 会提取数据生成对比信息图。

say.text: 用这些数据做一个统计卡片
say.note: 会突出几个数字做成卡片。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a complete infographic specification (layout, copy, data points, color scheme) from your content or data, outputting structured JSON or HTML ready for rendering in design tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'create an infographic', 'data visualization', 'social media graphic', or ask for a comparison chart, stat card, etc.

say_en.text: Create an infographic for this blog post.
Turn my LinkedIn post into a comparison chart.
Make a stat card from these numbers.
